Resolves #21016

### Summary

`Neo.button.Effect` now distinguishes a plain button from an unpressed toggle. A button constructed without `pressed` has neither the `pressed` class nor `aria-pressed`. A Boolean value publishes the corresponding accessibility state, and `pressed: true` also applies the class.

When an Effect button renders as a navigation link through `route` or `url`, it omits `aria-pressed` and retains its visual pressed state. Switching back to a button restores the attribute. Effect tab headers communicate their state through `aria-selected`.

Evidence: L2 (real Neo VDOM and state-transition unit tests) → L2 required by the ticket.

## AC Evidence

| Criterion | Evidence |
| --- | --- |
| Plain and toggle buttons | `test/playwright/unit/button/EffectAriaPressed.spec.mjs` checks plain, pressed and unpressed roots, including class and attribute updates. |
| Effect tab headers | The same spec checks `aria-selected` and absence of `aria-pressed` on both tab states. It also checks navigation links and transitions back to a button. |
| Existing button and tab behavior | The contributor ran the button, Grid SearchToolbar and tab suites at `2593eeef2e`: 174 tests passed. Contributor’s verification [QUARANTINED_URL: github.com] |

## Deltas from ticket

The Base button and Grid SearchToolbar implementation shipped earlier in #20833. This PR retains Kasa’s additional assertions for the Base button’s VDOM deltas and the SearchToolbar’s real case-sensitive toggle. The navigation-link coverage comes from Wren’s offered repair [QUARANTINED_URL: github.com].

## Test Evidence

Kasa reports 36 passing focused tests and 174 passing tests across the wider button, SearchToolbar and tab suites. Before integrating Wren’s repair, the five new Effect tests failed. All five passed with it.

## Post-Merge Validation

The acceptance criteria are covered by the unit suites above.

Authored by @Kasa-Harendra with Wren (@phoenixbycaselka). Emmy integrated the base and combined the contributions; Kasa adopted the result on this original PR and verified the final revision.

Hi @Kasa-Harendra, thank you for this. Two things in it are right: `null` meaning "a plain button", and the effect-based button needing the same semantics.

- #20829 was resolved on Nov 12 by #20833. - Your `src/button/Effect.mjs` change is the part `dev` still lacks. I filed it as #21016 and proposed you as its owner.

To land it:
1. Rebase onto `dev` and drop the `src/button/Base.mjs`, `src/grid/SearchToolbar.mjs` and matching spec changes, which are already on `dev`.
2. Keep `src/button/Effect.mjs`, and also make `Neo.tab.header.EffectButton#getVdomConfig()` drop `aria-pressed`. That class extends `Neo.button.Effect`, and a `role="tab"` element must not carry `aria-pressed`, because it states its selection through `aria-selected`. On `dev`, `Neo.tab.header.Button#afterSetPressed` (`src/tab/header/Button.mjs`) shows how #20833 handled the same case.
3. Add unit arms for both (the ACs of #21016), and change the PR body's close line to `Resolves #21016`.
